title: Streaming Agent Shell in Rust
tagline: Build a real stdin/stdout Rust action loop with bounded reads, an explicit command grammar, path containment, and streamed JSON events.
summary: Build a real stdin/stdout Rust action loop with bounded reads, an explicit command grammar, path containment, and streamed JSON events.
skills: Parse a deliberately small action language
Confine file tools to a bounded root
Stream bounded JSON events through real stdin
youWillBuild: An inspectable repository-observation process usable by different coding agents.
usefulFor: An inspectable repository-observation process usable by different coding agents.
JSONL requests use caller ids and explicit tool argument objects.

stages.title: Parse a deliberately small action language
stages.summary: Define an action enum for help, pwd, list, read, literal search and quit.
stages.languageWhy: Rust makes state ownership and fallible system calls explicit while keeping the implementation in the standard library.

stages.title: Confine file tools to a bounded root
stages.summary: Canonicalize the workspace root and requested targets, reject absolute and parent-traversing paths, and verify that symlinks remain inside the root.
stages.languageWhy: Rust makes state ownership and fallible system calls explicit while keeping the implementation in the standard library.

stages.title: Track budgets and terminal state
stages.summary: Wrap the tools in a session that owns its root, request count and closed state.
stages.languageWhy: Rust makes state ownership and fallible system calls explicit while keeping the implementation in the standard library.

stages.title: Stream bounded JSON events through real stdin
stages.summary: Read input incrementally with BufRead and cap each line before allocating an unbounded string.
stages.languageWhy: Rust makes state ownership and fallible system calls explicit while keeping the implementation in the standard library.
